task.title: Search and Genbeya links
task.body:
Find anything, and open what others share. See [[Experience#search]] and [[Experience#sharing-and-links]].

- [ ] Search field in every screen's top bar: names first, full text below, grouped by kind, hidden parts left out
- [ ] Full-text search in an isolate over the working tree, with excerpts as `search-engine.ts` makes them
- [ ] `genbeya://open?…` links registered on Android and iOS, parsed with the desktop's strict rules; open the clone with that remote or offer to clone
- [ ] **Copy Genbeya link** and **Copy web link** through the share sheet
